title: Use the Ignition Walkthrough context to clarify what a referenced “manual” differs from
summary: When a Day 2 support discussion references a “manual” and then says it is different from what it is now, use the Ignition walkthrough context labeled “Ignition Walkthrough 120” to identify the current Ignition-based interface meaning being contrasted—rather than assuming the earlier “manual” reference refers to the same live surface.
when_to_use: Use during live support when a customer or internal speaker references a “manual” and then states that what it is now is different, and the segment includes an Ignition walkthrough context label (e.g., “Ignition Walkthrough 120”).
not_for: Do not use this procedure to determine the operational steps of the “manual” itself, because the segment does not name the manual or specify which live Ignition screen/controls it refers to beyond the contrast sentence.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Locate the Ignition walkthrough context label in the referenced segment and use it to frame the correct live Ignition-based meaning being contrasted.

L1_support: If the segment does not identify what the “manual” is or what it differs from beyond the single contrast sentence, stop and request the next/previous segment that contains the missing details.
access_or_tools_needed: Training video playback for segment around 02:44:45–02:44:50
Ability to view/confirm the “Ignition Walkthrough 120” frame

visual_references.description: Frame showing the Ignition walkthrough context label “Ignition Walkthrough 120” and the contrast sentence: “So you mentioned a manual, but what that is now it's different from”.

steps.title: Locate the Ignition walkthrough reference in the segment
steps.purpose: Establish the current Ignition-based walkthrough context that the speaker is using as the basis for the contrast.
steps.instruction: In the referenced Day 2 segment, find the frame labeled “Ignition Walkthrough 120”.
steps.expected_result: You can point to the frame where the OCR text reads “Ignition Walkthrough 120”.
steps.healthy_condition: The segment you are using contains the “Ignition Walkthrough 120” label in the visible frame.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the “Ignition Walkthrough 120” frame or the segment content you have does not include that label.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the segment you have does not show “Ignition Walkthrough 120”, stop and request the correct segment/frame that contains the walkthrough label.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text reads: "Ignition Walkthrough 120"; transcript: "So you mentioned a manual, but what that is now it's different from".

steps.title: Confirm the exact contrast statement about “manual” vs what it is now
steps.purpose: Capture the precise wording that indicates a difference between the earlier “manual” reference and the current context.
steps.instruction: Listen to/confirm the contrast sentence in the segment: “So you mentioned a manual, but what that is now it's different from”.
steps.expected_result: You can quote or paraphrase the contrast sentence exactly as it appears in the segment transcript.
steps.healthy_condition: The transcript in the segment includes the contrast sentence about “manual” and “what that is now”.
steps.failure_condition: The segment transcript you have does not include the contrast sentence, or the wording is materially different.

actions.label: Confirm contrast sentence
actions.exact_action: Confirm the transcript sentence: “So you mentioned a manual, but what that is now it's different from”.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot confirm the contrast sentence, stop and request the correct segment/time range.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: "So you mentioned a manual, but what that is now it's different from".

steps.title: Identify the live Ignition-based meaning being contrasted
steps.purpose: Use the Ignition walkthrough context label as the anchor for what “it is now” refers to in live support discussions.
steps.instruction: Treat the Ignition walkthrough context labeled “Ignition Walkthrough 120” as the current/updated Ignition-based interface meaning being contrasted against the earlier “manual” reference.
steps.expected_result: Your clarification states that the earlier “manual” reference is not the same as the current Ignition walkthrough context labeled “Ignition Walkthrough 120”.
steps.healthy_condition: Your clarification explicitly ties “what it is now” to the Ignition walkthrough context shown in the segment.
steps.failure_condition: Your clarification conflates the earlier “manual” reference with the Ignition walkthrough context shown in “Ignition Walkthrough 120”.

actions.label: Frame clarification using Ignition walkthrough context
actions.exact_action: State that the “manual” reference is different from the current Ignition walkthrough context shown as “Ignition Walkthrough 120”.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the segment does not specify what the “manual” is (which live surface/controls) or what it differs from beyond the single contrast sentence, stop and seek the next/previous segment that contains the missing details.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Segment contains only the contrast sentence and the “Ignition Walkthrough 120” label; it does not name the manual or identify the specific live surface/controls for the earlier “manual” reference.
Ignition Walkthrough 120 appears on the training slide frame for Day 2 segment 0032, indicating this source segment is part of an Ignition walkthrough.

steps.title: Record the clarification you can support from the segment
steps.purpose: Ensure the live support response stays grounded in what the segment actually provides.
steps.instruction: Record a clarification that the “manual” reference is not the same as the current Ignition walkthrough context shown in “Ignition Walkthrough 120”. Do not add details about what the “manual” specifically is unless another segment provides it.
steps.expected_result: Your recorded clarification contains only: (1) the existence of a “manual” reference, (2) the contrast sentence, and (3) the anchor that “what it is now” corresponds to “Ignition Walkthrough 120”.
steps.healthy_condition: No additional manual identity or specific Ignition controls are asserted beyond what the segment provides.
steps.failure_condition: You record or communicate a specific identity for the “manual” (e.g., a particular Ignition screen/control) that is not named in the segment.

actions.label: Write grounded clarification
actions.exact_action: Record that the “manual” reference is different from the current Ignition walkthrough context labeled “Ignition Walkthrough 120”.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you need the specific identity of the “manual” or the exact difference beyond the contrast sentence, stop and request the next/previous segment.
